name: ChatMessage
label: Chat message
description: A single chat turn with avatar, author, timestamp, and bubble or plain content aligned by role.

props.name: role
props.description:
Which side of the conversation this turn belongs to. Drives alignment
and the default surface: user turns are right-aligned bubbles,
assistant turns are surface-less full-width text. Shadows the ARIA
role attribute; the root renders no ARIA role.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Avatar slot, e.g. an `<Avatar>`. Omit for no gutter at all.

props.name: showAvatar
props.description:
Show the passed avatar. When false the avatar is hidden but its gutter
space is kept, so consecutive rows in a run stay aligned.

props.name: author
props.description: Display name shown above the content.

props.name: timestamp
props.description: Time shown beside the author, e.g. "2:41 PM". Free text, so callers keep their own formatting.

props.name: grouped
props.description:
Consecutive-message mode: hides the avatar (keeping its gutter), drops
the author and timestamp, and tightens the spacing to the row above.

props.name: bubble
props.description:
Override the role's default surface. Explicit true on an assistant turn
renders a received bubble; explicit false on a user turn renders plain text.

props.name: tail
props.description:
Square the speaker-side bottom corner of the bubble — bottom-right on a
sent bubble, bottom-left on a received one. Only meaningful when a
bubble renders.

props.name: size
props.description: Compact drops the type one size step and tightens the bubble padding.

props.name: pending
props.description: Waiting for the first content: renders a three-dot pulse in place of children.

props.name: pendingLabel
props.description: Accessible text announced for the pending state.

props.name: actions
props.description: Action row under the content, revealed on hover and keyboard focus (always visible on touch) — `showActions` pins it on.

props.name: showActions
props.description:
Always show the action row instead of revealing it on hover and focus.
For surfaces where the actions are part of the response — a copy or
feedback row — rather than a secondary affordance.

props.name: attachments
props.description:
Files sent with this turn, drawn outside the bubble on the speaker's
side, above the text. Pass an AttachmentGroup. A turn that carries
files and no text draws no bubble at all.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer slot under the content — a sources row, an edited note.

props.name: children
props.description:
The message content. The package ships no markdown renderer; render
markdown yourself, ideally wrapped in Prose, and pass the result.
